_doc: Investor Atlas v3 Present-mode chapters (design spec §10.6). build.py inlines this file as ATLAS_CONFIG.story for the investor_v3 app (apps/investor/story.json stays the v2 story). Same six views, cameras, chapter-3 filters and 9 s autoplay as v2; the copy is shorter (two-line bodies) and titles carry no digits. New fields read by apps/investor_v3/v3-present.js: kicker (the eyebrow suffix, 'Chapter 2 / 6 · Serviceable market') and stats[].cap (a caption; on the contract-value stat of chapters 1, 2 and 4 it becomes the right-hand figure of the hero, elsewhere a small line under the figure; a leading {token} is set as the figure). Every stats[].expr is a key of RBX.present.STAT in core/js/investor/present.js, and {tokens} in body, labels and caps are computed from data at runtime ({rev.t1up} is registered by v3-present.js); nothing numeric is typed here except the 8.0p wholesale baseline and the 3% CPI assumption, which the model states. *phrase* renders in the accent colour (no italics). filters = {set: [visible values]} on an all-visible baseline; camera = {fit:view} or {center,zoom,pitch?,bearing?,terrain?}; ppa = PPA section to scroll to.

chapters.title: Every *subsidised generator* in Great Britain
chapters.body: Biogas, biomass, EfW, landfill and sewage-gas generators with RO or FiT accreditation: the market RenewaBlox can address.

chapters.title: *AD peakers* the grid pays to flex
chapters.body: {sam.n} AD peakers matched to the Balancing Mechanism, sized by contract value. Hollow rings still await a BM figure.

chapters.title: Where flexibility *pays most*
chapters.body: Tier 1 and 2 sites cluster around London, Kent and East Anglia, where the grid is tightest and offers are called most often.

chapters.title: Stranded hydro in *the Highlands*
chapters.body: Run-of-river schemes generating more than the network will take. The stranded share mines Bitcoin around the clock.

chapters.title: FiT export overtakes *the forward curve*
chapters.body: Guaranteed FiT export rises with CPI while the forward curve falls. At 3% CPI it passes the Cal-28 forward.

chapters.title: Who *buys the power*
chapters.body: The largest external REGO certificate holder for each site: strong evidence of the offtaker, not contractual proof.
